items.title: Jackson interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2010
items.q: Art was called “The Volcano” by Dizzy

ctx.x: Well that was the look of his presentation. And so I’m not saying that he wasn’t very dynamic and very strong, but I mean in a conversation with Elvin, he was so articulate and so specific in his thoughts about the music and his ideas, and his feelings towards the musicians. And so that’s what I mean in terms of a very loving appreciation for him to have been able to have played the drums with these different artists. But obviously on

stage he was a killer, to coin a phrase. But I mean he absolutely was. There was nothing about him that was — it was loving but it still had a certain energy and passion that you know, Art was called “The Volcano” by Dizzy and Elvin was nicknamed “Thunder.”
